headlines.title: 구윤철 " 외환시장 예의주시...과도한 쏠림엔 즉시 조치 "
headlines.summary: 미국 관세와 이란 전쟁 영향에 외환시장 변동성이 커진 가운데 구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관은 지나친 쏠림에는 필요한 조치를 즉시 취할 것이라고 밝혔습니다. 구 부총리는 오늘 오전 정부서울청사에서 주재한 시장상황점검회의에서 대외 불확실성이 높은 상황에서 불안 심리가 확산하지 않도록 높은 경계감을 가지고 예의주시하고 있다며 이같이 언급했습니다.

headlines.title: 구윤철 " 과도한 쏠림 즉시 대응 "… 환율 변동성 확대 경계
headlines.summary: 중동 전쟁·외국인 순매도에 외환시장 변동성 확대 정부, 금융·외환시장 리스크 점검 강화 채권시장 변동성에도 관계기관 공조 대응 [서울=뉴시스] 고범준 기자 = 이재명 대통령이 2일 청와대에서 열린 제24회 국무회의 겸 제11차 비상경제점검회의에서 구윤철 경제부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관과 대화하고 있다. 2026.06.02. bjko@newsis.

headlines.title: 환율 13.6원 오른 1530원 개장 … 2009년 ‘글로벌 금융위기’ 이후 처음
headlines.summary: 5월 외환보유액 8.8억달러 감소 구윤철, 시장개입 가능성도 시사 환율 ‘고공행진’ 4일 오전 서울 중구 하나은행 본점 딜링룸 현황판 앞을 한 직원이 지나가고 있다. 이날 원·달러 환율은 전날 주간 거래 종가보다 13.6원 오른 1530.0원에 개장했는데, 환율이 1530원을 넘겨 거래를 시작한 것은 글로벌 금융위기였던 2009년 3월 10일(1554.

headlines.title: 원/달러 환율 , 3월 이후 첫 1530원 돌파…美 관세 · 중동 영향 겹쳤다
headlines.summary: (서울=뉴스1) 권현진 기자 = 4일 오전 서울 중구 하나은행 본점 딜링룸 전광판에 코스피와 원·달러 환욜이 표시되고 있다. 이날 환율은 미국과 이란의 군사적 충돌 재개에 강달러 기조가 강해지며 달러·원 환율이 1530원까지 치솟았다. 코스피는 전 거래일 대비 177.67포인트(2.02%) 내린 8,623.82로 출발했다. 2026.6.

headlines.title: 환율 두달 만에 다시 1530원대로
headlines.summary: 장중 1530.8원, 3월 31일 이후 최고치 외환보유액도 5월 8억8000만弗 감소 이란의 미군기지 공격에 유가 등 상승 구윤철 “과도 쏠림 즉시 조치 취할 것” 원/달러 환율이 약 두 달 만에 1530원을 다시 돌파했다. 시작가 기준으로는 글로벌 금융위기 이후 처음이다. 서울 중구 명동 일대 환전소 모습.

headlines.title: OECD 한국 성장 률 2.6% 전망, G20중 전망 상향폭 최대
headlines.summary: 세계경제 성장률 전망치, 3월(2.9%) 대비 하향된 2.8% 제시 한국경제 성장률은 같은 기간 1.7%→2.6%, G20국가 중 상향폭 최대 (부산=뉴스1) 윤일지 기자 = 지난 3월 우리나라 수출이 반도체 '슈퍼 사이클'(초호황)에 힘입어 사상 처음으로 800억 달러를 돌파하며 역대 최대 실적을 기록했다.

headlines.title: 닭고기 수급난 … 굽네치킨, 가격 인상 대신 중량 줄였다
headlines.summary: 닭다리살 순살·윙봉·통다리 중량 축소 ‘치킨 중량 표시제’ 시행 6개월만 첫사례 “판매가·공급가 인상 어렵자 고육지책” [굽네치킨 홈페이지] 고병원성 AI(조류인플루엔자) 여파로 닭고기 수급난을 겪는 프랜차이즈 치킨업계에서 중량 조정 사례가 나왔다. 정부가 슈링크플레이션 방지를 위해 ‘치킨 중량 표시제’를 시행한 지 약 6개월 만이다.

headlines.title: 중소기업 10곳 중 7곳 “원부자재값 20%이상↑”

key_headlines.title: Korean Won Breaks 1,530 Per Dollar for First Time Since 2009 Financial Crisis
key_headlines.summary: The won-dollar exchange rate surged past 1,530 won due to strong dollar momentum amid US-Iran military tensions and US tariff measures. This marks the first time since the 2009 global financial crisis that the won opened above this level.

key_headlines.title: South Korea Targets 1 Trillion Dollar Export Mark with 900 Billion Dollar Goal This Year
key_headlines.summary: Building on last year's record 700 billion dollar exports, Korea aims for 900 billion dollars in 2026 and eyes becoming the world's fifth largest exporter. Semiconductor and power equipment exports are driving growth in the AI era.

key_headlines.title: Concrete Mixer Truck Strike Threatens Semiconductor Construction Sites in Capital Region
key_headlines.summary: Ready-mix concrete transporters in the Seoul metropolitan area plan complete operational shutdown from June 8th, threatening to halt major construction projects including semiconductor facilities in Pyeongtaek and Yongin.

key_headlines.title: Foreign Investors Dump 7 Trillion Won in Korean Stocks Amid Middle East Tensions
key_headlines.summary: Foreign investors engaged in massive net selling of 7 trillion won in Korean stocks, marking the second-largest selloff on record, causing the KOSPI to fall 1% and the won-dollar rate to breach 1,540.

key_headlines.title: OECD Cuts Global Growth Forecast to 2.8% Citing Middle East Crisis Impact
key_headlines.summary: The OECD lowered its 2026 global economic growth forecast and warned of potential recession risks in multiple economies if Middle East energy crisis persists, with inflation pressures expected to rise significantly.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy faces mounting external pressures as the won-dollar exchange rate surged past 1,530 won for the first time since 2009, driven by US-Iran military tensions and strong dollar positioning. The nation's export sector shows resilience with 900 billion dollars targeted for 2026 and potential ranking as the world's fifth largest exporter, buoyed by AI-driven semiconductor and power equipment demand. However, domestic supply chains face disruption as ready-mix concrete transporters prepare for a complete operational shutdown from June 8th, threatening major construction projects including critical semiconductor facilities. Financial markets remain volatile with foreign investors dumping record amounts of Korean stocks amid geopolitical uncertainties.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The OECD has downgraded the 2026 global economic growth forecast to 2.8%, citing escalating Middle East tensions as a major risk factor. The organization warned that if the energy crisis intensifies, global growth could plummet to single digits, while unemployment rates rise and inflation pressures expand significantly. South Korea's current account surplus reached a record second-place 28.3 billion dollars in April, bolstered by strong semiconductor and IT exports, marking 36 consecutive months of trade surpluses. The Federal Reserve's Beige Book confirmed employment stagnation and expanding inflation pressures, with market expectations for interest rate maintenance at the upcoming FOMC meeting despite hawkish signals from some Fed officials.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI declined 1.84% to close at 8,639.41 on June 4th, weighed down by massive foreign investor net selling of 6.66 trillion won and weak US semiconductor earnings. The won-dollar exchange rate breached 1,540 territory amid geopolitical tensions and continued foreign portfolio outflows, with 19 consecutive trading days of foreign net selling. Individual investors provided counter-support with 5 trillion won in net purchases while institutional investors bought 1.8 trillion won, but could not offset foreign withdrawals. The technology sector particularly suffered as major chipmakers Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix fell over 2%, though the KOSDAQ rose 2% aided by materials, components, and equipment sector strength.
sections.Industry & Technology: SK Innovation partnered with Bill Gates to develop advanced nuclear reactors in the US as part of SK Group's strategy to build a comprehensive energy ecosystem supporting semiconductors, batteries, and AI operations. LG Chemistry is expected to deliver surprisingly strong second-quarter results driven by improved energy storage system production efficiency and increased EV battery sales. Korean secondary battery makers are positioned to benefit from EU's de-risking China supply chain initiatives, capturing market share from Chinese competitors. Samsung Electronics topped the KOSPI's year-to-date stock gainers list with a 5.72% rise, driven by robust demand for AI server components and high-performance semiconductor parts.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul Mayor-elect Oh Se-hoon's victory is expected to accelerate private redevelopment and reconstruction projects citywide, with ambitious targets to start construction on 310,000 housing units by 2031. Key policy shifts include faster project approvals and expanded private-sector led housing supply to stabilize prices, representing a divergence from the government's stricter regulations. Price-capped apartment complexes in the capital region are attracting 2.5 times higher subscription rates than regular developments as homebuyers seek affordability amid surging housing prices. Concerns about falling jeonse (lease deposit) arrangements and surging monthly rent payments in Seoul remain critical issues requiring policy intervention.
sections.International Economy: The US Federal Reserve is showing increasing hawkish sentiment with multiple officials, including Trump-aligned appointees, signaling possible interest rate hikes, contradicting earlier expectations of rate cuts. The USTR representative pledged to respect existing bilateral trade agreements with the EU and Japan, assuring that new tariff measures will not undermine established trade deals. US stock markets declined with the Nasdaq falling 0.89% and Nasdaq 0.1% amid Middle East tensions, semiconductor sector weakness, and expectations of rising oil prices feeding inflation concerns. Currency and interest rate markets are pricing in significant probability of Fed rate hikes by December, with CME FedWatch showing 41.1% likelihood compared to just 9.1% one month prior.
sections.AI & Economy: Big Tech's top four AI infrastructure investment needs reach approximately 800 trillion won, with companies like Alphabet conducting massive equity raises of 130 trillion won to partially fund these expenditures, revealing that internal cash flows alone cannot sustain investment demands. The EU is urging households to reduce evening electricity consumption as AI data centers and electric vehicle expansion create unprecedented peak-hour power demand pressures. Focus AI completed an 8 billion won capital raise to strengthen finances and accelerate expansion of AI physical security and industrial safety solutions. South Korea's AI 3-Power initiative shows mixed progress with positive developments in AIDC special legislation and GPU procurement, but inter-departmental coordination remains sluggish.
sections.Others: Seven regions in Gyeongsang and Jeolla provinces will be designated as new regulatory-free zones focused on energy and biotech sectors to foster regional industrial development. Quantinuum, a quantum computing subsidiary of Honeywell, achieved successful NASDAQ listing as the first quantum computing decacorn, though it subsequently surrendered intraday gains. Global private equity firm EQT strategically acquired Korean companies Dmore and Remember to capitalize on AI-driven industrial restructuring opportunities. Trump's administration is pushing forward with a small modular reactor (SMR) renaissance, with SK-backed TerraPower achieving major construction milestones in the US desert.
